tax.title: Tax & Declarations
tax.subtitle: Payroll tax (loonbelasting), AOV and statutory declarations — prepared from approved payroll.
tax.rulesPending: The statutory rules in use are pending legal verification. Calculations and declarations are marked “pending legal validation” and cannot be approved without an explicit acknowledgement.
tax.dashboardSub: Monthly return “loonbelasting en premie AOV”. Drafts are prepared automatically when payroll is approved.
tax.howSub: ARA Payroll prepares the declaration; you submit it yourself through the official channel.

how.1: Review the draft and approve it — the files are generated (PDF, Excel, CSV).
how.2: Download the declaration and the supporting schedules.
how.3: File the monthly return for loonbelasting and AOV premium in the online portal of the Belastingdienst (filing window reported as the 26th to the 10th of the following month — verify).
how.4: Record the submission date and reference in ARA Payroll and upload the receipt.
how.5: Record acceptance and payment when confirmed. ARA Payroll never marks a declaration as submitted on its own.

tax.noApi: No official API or automated submission method of the tax authorities was found; ARA Payroll does not log in to government portals.

tax.aovIntro: AOV is reported separately from payroll tax. Under the researched rules the premium is withheld from the employee; any employer share is an employer obligation and is never deducted from net pay.

sectionSub.DEDUCTION: For example health insurance, pension contribution, FVO, loan repayment, salary advance or union contribution.
sectionSub.EMPLOYER: Employer contributions; these are never deducted from net pay.
